0.4.description:
Bit more expiremental with progressive items.
They're mostly in progressive bundles. progressive gears are random from a pool but the pool size increases as you find progressive gears. the rest are set. Not married to each catagory but tried to seperate some stuff and make it more obvious what is what.

Added some more logic to hopefully smooth out the run a bit.
Xion not having keyblade should be fixed now.
Fixed some item database stuff as well.
